messages:
elaine: Quick sync — planning to push kernel v2.14 + quant-profile slim-v3 to a single canary slice tonight at 23:00 PST. Who can own smoke verification and be ready to trigger rollback if we see perf regressions?

kumar: I can take smoke ownership. Will run the perf checks and spot-check tail latencies.

jon: I can be on-call for rollback and follow up on the monitoring alerts. Ping me 15m before cutover.

rachael: Heads up — I merged the thin-client change that depends on the kernel flags. Canary needs that flag toggled: `runtime.enable_prefetch=true`.

ash: Quick question on the quant change — slim-v3 includes 4-bit mix. Do we have a fallback quant profile if generation quality drops?

elaine: Good call. Fallback plan: auto-fallback to slim-v2 (3-bit stable) on >=5% quality regression measured on our canary prompts. We'll run the A/B eval set immediately post-deploy.

elaine: Kumar — I put a short smoke checklist below, keep me updated in-thread.

kumar: Copy.

elaine: ```
SMOKE CHECKLIST (canary)
- deploy to slice `canary-07` only
- flip `runtime.enable_prefetch=true`
- apply kernel v2.14 and quant profile slim-v3
- run perf-runner: `./perf-runner --seq 512 --rps 40 --duration 10m`
- run quality probes: `./eval_set run --set canary-ab`
- validate latency p50/p95 and token cost taxon
- confirm no error spike > 0.5%
- if quality delta >= 5% or p95 increases > 30% => rollback
```

jon: For rollback: `deploy rollback --to-profile slim-v2 --slice canary-07` should be enough. I'll be ready to execute.

rachael: I'll watch the logging dashboards and spot-check traces. If I see KV cache misses, I will call it out.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment request accepted: kernel v2.14 + quant slim-v3 -> canary-07 @ 2026-03-17T23:00:00-08:00. Approvals: elaine, kumar.

ash: Thumbs up from infra — capacity available. Small note: watch for electron-prefetch flag interaction on GPU 4.

kumar: Starting preflight now: running `./smoke preflight --slice canary-07` (5m). Will post results here.

elaine: Thanks. Jon, I'll DM you 15m prior to the push to confirm rollback cadence.

jon: Good. I'll be by my laptop and monitoring alerts channel.

kumar: Preflight done: quick perf looks fine, no regressions on p50/p95 in the synthetic run. Uploading logs to the canary artifact bucket.

rachael: Reviewing logs — no obvious KV spike. Ready to proceed on my side.

elaine: Alright — proceeding with scheduled push. Will update thread when stages complete. :rocket:

(15m later)

elainE: stage 1 (kernel + quant apply) finished on canary-07. Running eval set now.

kumar: Eval run complete. Quality delta = 1.2% (within threshold). Latency p95 +12% (within safe margin). No errors.

jon: Observability checks green. No telemetry alerts triggered.

rachael: Traces look healthy. Rolling to extended canary window for 30m.

ash: Noted minor GC bump on node g4-12, but stable.

elaine: Great — keeping extended window. If anything changes call rollback. Otherwise we'll schedule next slice tomorrow.

kumar: I'll leave a quick post-deploy checklist in the runbook and mark this canary as passed.

elaine: Thanks team. Closing thread after 30m window.

(30m later)

kumar: Extended window complete, no issues observed. Marking canary-07 as passed.

elaine: Thanks all — follow-ups: create a short postmortem-ish note with perf deltas and cost impact, then we can plan stagger to more slices tomorrow.

jon: Ack. I'll draft the rollback playbook updates just in case.

rachael: I'll file the change in the release notes and add the flag note.

deploy-bot: Deployment completed: kernel v2.14 + quant slim-v3 -> canary-07. Status: PASS.

elaine: Closing. :white_check_mark:
